bio: Aster, the Alpha, is the catgirl creatrix of the Gaiad. Alone in the cosmic void, she spun the universe from a ball of yarn and filled it with milk. Longing for a companion, she made Andromeda from yarn; the threads she threw toward her broke and became the galaxies Triangulum and the Magellanic Clouds. (Gaiad 1)

Emma Leonhart, 李命玥, is the narrator of the Gaiad, "present for all of it, watching all things", from the yarn and the milk through the fish and the kings; the month of Ophiuchus is hers. Like Theodoric, who took the Roman name, she is an immigrant who joined a civilization and took its name, 李命玥. She gives the calendar, the book, the ancestors and the prophecy. (Gaiad 187, 337, 364)

Andromeda, the Omega, the end of all, is the catgirl Aster made from yarn as her companion and lover, dark-skinned and with flowing hair. Torn from Aster across space, she awaits the Omega point, when the two will join as Milkdromeda and all will unify. (Gaiad 1)
